text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered: p99 latency for /v1/generate > 3.5s (5m window) — page fired to oncall rotation

mike: acked. I'm on it. grabbing dashboard now.

sara: oncall? I see p95 climbing too, started ~10m ago. any customer-facing errors?

mike: no 5xxs, just long tails. looks like KV cache miss rate spiked for tokencache-eu.* metrics show hotkeys.
nate: I can try temporary hotkey eviction rule. will run a cache-evict on affected shard.
mike: good. also bumping autoscaler min for dedicated-pool-2 to 3 -> 5 to absorb bursts. doing kubectl patch now.
helen: paging PD just in case. enterprise tier could see SLO impact. tagging accounts team.

mike: running: `kubectl -n inference patch hpa dedicated-pool-2 --patch '{"spec":{"minReplicas":5}}'`
sara: +1 to evict hotkeys, but if it's request fanout we may need to route to fallback model.

sre-bot: autoscaler: scale up initiated for nodepool-g4x at 1716203220 (expected add 2 GPUs)

nate: evict command done: `redis-cli -h kv-cache-01 EVAL "return redis.call('DEL', KEYS[1])" 1 hotkey:abc123` — cache miss rate dropping slightly.
mike: metrics: p99 down from 3.8s -> 2.1s after autoscale + evict. still above SLO target 1.5s.
helen: can we fallback routing to smaller model variant for non-enterprise tenants? use routing policy alpha-fallback.
sara: switching route policy: `redwoodctl routes set /v1/generate --policy prefer-low-latency --fallback mistral-7b-q4`

incident-bot: PagerDuty: page escalated to oncall-lead at 1716203275 (no ack from PD first responder)
oncall-lead: acknowledged. visible timeline? need a quick customer impact note for support.
mike: preliminary: ~6% of requests hitting p99>2s in last 15m, mostly EU edge. no errors. recommend: keep autoscale and route fallback, monitor COGS impact.
ate: deploying route change now.
sara: route change applied, routing ~30% of new requests to mistral-7b-q4 as warm fallback.

helen: support note draft: "We observed an elevated latency event impacting a subset of inference traffic in EU. We applied autoscale and routing fallback; tail latency reduced. No customer data loss. Working on root cause (KV hotkey + request fanout)." want me to post to status?
oncall-lead: yes, post as a maintenance/incident update and mention ETA for RCA in 6 hours.

mike: p99 now steady ~1.6s. p95 back under 1.2s. still monitoring.
sara: starting a short postmortem tracking doc: https://internal/redwood/incident/1716203123 (placeholder)

helen: any follow-ups immediate? I want playbook items: hotkey detection alert, adaptive eviction rule, route fallback test.

mike: agree. also add: tighten autoscaler hysteresis to avoid slow warmups, adjust minReplica by region for peak hours.
nate: will add hotkey blacklist rule to staging and run load test.

sre-bot: Incident timer: incident open 00:11:27

mike: handing off to sara for next shift — I'm heading offline in 12m. Sara, you have notes in the doc and PD acknowledgement.
sara: taking over. I have endpoint debug links and the eviction commands in the doc. will monitor for 30m and escalate if p99 > 2s again.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: oncall rotation updated — reassigned to sara at 1716203348

sara: confirmed takeover. final note: customer impact contained, mitigations applied (autoscale + KV eviction + route fallback). RCA ticket created.
mike: thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
helen: nice recovery. lets capture next steps in retro.

sara: closing slack thread, will post status update in 10.
